subject: Starter Plan: Aligning Champion, Stakeholders, and Success Criteria
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novagen.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novagen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter Plan: Aligning Champion, Stakeholders, and Success Criteria

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time to get this rolling. As discussed on the call last week, I wanted to bring together a short starter plan so we have a shared view of success and clear owners for the evaluation. Karthik (AE) and Marissa (CS) are looped in to support technical + adoption items.

High-level goals (what success looks like):
- Run a two-week evaluation that validates Redwood's latency and cost targets for your document summarization workload
- Confirm integration approach for secure private deployments (VPC + KMS)
- Produce an internal decision memo for Novagen's platform committee by 2027-10-15

Proposed timeline (first pass):
1) Technical review & access provision — week of 2027-09-27
2) Run evaluation & collect metrics — 2027-10-04 through 2027-10-15
3) Decision meeting with platform committee — target 2027-10-15

Attachments: Novagen-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf (starter plan + roles) and Proposed-Timeline-2027Q4.xlsx (dates you saw on the call).

Quick asks from Alex/Priya: can you confirm the internal stakeholders who should be on weekly check-ins (engineering, security, procurement)? Also flag any hard dates we should avoid.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendar invites once we have the roster.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novagen.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novagen.com>, IT Security <security@novagen.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter Plan: Aligning Champion, Stakeholders, and Success Criteria

Irene — thanks for pulling this together. This looks good overall. Confirming stakeholders on our side:
- Alex Rivera (Champion / Product) — primary contact for goals + outcome
- Priya Shah (Head of Platform) — decisioning for infra + procurement
- Mateo Gomez (SRE) — technical lead for access and baseline tests (will add him to invites)
- IT Security (security@novagen.com) — they’ll need the security/compliance packet before any private deployment tests

Hard constraints: we have a code freeze 2027-10-07 to 2027-10-10 across platform teams, so please avoid scheduling major infra changes in that window.

I’ve attached a short list of internal reviewers (see inline). For the timeline, the proposed dates look fine — we’d prefer the decision meeting on 2027-10-15 in the afternoon (PST).

Forwarding to Mateo and security for the technical kickoff.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Director, Product
Novagen Therapeutics
alex.rivera@novagen.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novagen.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novagen.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter Plan: Aligning Champion, Stakeholders, and Success Criteria

Thanks Alex — noted on the code freeze window. Couple of practical next steps from our side so the evaluation is high signal: 

1) Access & scope
- We’ll request a short-term sandbox VPC or temporary service account with read-only access to the dataset for the eval. If Novagen prefers we run in Redwood Private, we’ll share a checklist for KMS and network requirements.

2) Baseline tests (week of 2027-09-27) — proposed agenda:
- 30m: Intro + access verification (SRE + security)
- 60m: Sample-run to validate tokenization / payload sizes
- 30m: Confirm metrics dashboard and alerting (latency, error-rate, token cost)

3) Roles for the weekly 30-minute syncs (starting 2027-09-28):
- Alex — business outcomes and decision criteria
- Priya — procurement + platform approvals
- Mateo (SRE) — technical signoff
- Irene — solution architecture & test plan owner
- Karthik/Marissa — Redwood enablement + support

I attached the checklist and a lightweight runbook in the PDF we shared earlier. Marissa will send calendar invites for the baseline meeting; please let us know preferred timing for 2027-09-28 (morning PST or afternoon PST).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novagen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novagen.com>
Cc: Mateo Gomez <mateo.gomez@novagen.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, IT Security <security@novagen.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter Plan: Aligning Champion, Stakeholders, and Success Criteria

Thanks all — afternoon PST on 2027-09-28 works for our SRE and security folks. Mateo, can you take the lead for the access checklist? Security, please confirm what additional evidence you need (SOC2, network diagrams, KMS attestation).

Alex — we’ll aim for the decision meeting 2027-10-15 at 2:00 PM PST.

Irene / Karthik / Marissa — please send the calendar invites and include the baseline runbook and a short agenda.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform, Novagen Therapeutics
priya.shah@novagen.com
